VBO:0200162.summary: Bichons often form close attachments to their people, and each breed has its own character. The cheerful, outgoing Bichon Frise and playful Havanese contrast with the generally calm Bolognese. Alongside the Maltese, they belong to a companion-dog family with Mediterranean roots.
VBO:0200162.shortDescription: Often closely attached to people, the Bichon family includes cheerful, playful and calmer companion breeds.
